test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight men can complete a work in 54 days. In how many days will 6 men and 12 boys complete the same work if one man works as much as 2 boys?
solution:
**Given:**

Eight men can complete a work in 54 days

One man works as much as 2 boys

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency of the worker × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

1 man = 2 boys

⇒ man/boy = 2/1

Let the efficiency of man and boy be 2x and x

So, total work = 8 × 2x × 54

⇒ 864x units

Now,

6 men and 12 boys = 6 × 2x + 12 × x

⇒ 12x + 12x

⇒ 24x

Now,

Required time = 864x/24x

⇒ 36 days

**∴ The same will be completed by 6 men and 12 boys in 36 days.**
